testResults.name: scripted-venue
testResults.result: 8 tests passed for fire-and-forget commands, ordered callbacks, acknowledgement, partial/final fills, rejection, expiry, immediate fill, cancellation, replacement, and position snapshots.

testResults.name: focused-quality
testResults.result: Focused Ruff lint, Ruff format, and ty checks passed with no wall-clock, random, or network access.

decisions: Venue commands return no outcomes; all reports, fills, and positions re-enter through EventBus.
ScriptedVenue consumes an immutable FIFO script and fails mismatched calls without consuming a step.
